facts.business: Ushakiran Finance Limited is a Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit taking NBFC registered with RBI, primarily engaged in investment activities in equity markets and financing activities.
key_risks: Capital market fluctuations affecting gains and profitability
Defaults and NPAs in financing activity
Difficulty in raising funds from banks due to lending restrictions to small NBFCs
Dependency on borrowing from Directors and Inter-corporate loans
facts.related_party_note: Related parties include Directors (T. Adinarayana, T. Govardhana Rao, Sridevi Madati, T.R. Sekhar), Company Secretary (Sanjana Jain), Manager (Omprakash Koyalkar), CFO (T. Ramesh Babu), and enterprises related to promoters/directors (M/s. Sigachi Laboratories Limited and M/s. Krishnaraj Securities Private Limited). Remuneration paid to KMPs: Sanjana Jain Rs 3.24 lakhs, Omprakash Koyalkar Rs 3.21 lakhs, T. Ramesh Babu Rs 4.62 lakhs in FY 2025-26. No remuneration paid to Directors.
